changes.new_statement: A licensed physician may waive child restraints for weight, physical fitness or other medical grounds. The transporter must carry the signed statement identifying the child and the reason. Drivers must secure children properly; a first conviction costs fifty dollars, and a later offense can carry a five-hundred-dollar penalty.
